area: dress up: plants the 🗡️ sword cuts grow back (🌱 in ⚙️ Advanced, under 🌗 night and day)
text: M wants the cut plants to regrow. A 🌱 cut plants grow back setting in ⚙️ Advanced, under 🌗 night and day, on to start: a cut plant comes back by itself about 2 minutes after it was cut (a slider for how long), even while you are somewhere else; with 🌗 night and day on, by the next morning, so sleeping in a bed grows back everything you cut. Plants put in a place (a bush, a cactus) are kept as cut, not deleted, so they can grow back too. Later, maybe: a 🌱 sprout where a plant was cut.
source: Matthew, 2026-10-30 07:3x, in chat: "M wants a way for the plants that are cut to regrow --- What do you think? Where should we control that?" Then, to the plan (on to start, ~2 minutes; by the next morning with night and day on; in ⚙️ Advanced): "build it. good plan."
